verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs say the Developer Platform API is defined in an OpenAPI 3.1 specification, with a dedicated codegen guide for generating typed clients in any language. That implies the spec is published for programmatic use. The probe's 404s at guessed paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) show only that the spec is not at those conventional URLs; they do not contradict its existence. missing for 10: an explicit documented download URL for the spec, confirmation that it covers the widget/legacy APIs beyond the Platform API, independent or hands-on retrieval of the file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The MoonPay Developer Platform API is defined using an OpenAPI 3.1 specification. You can use this spec to generate typed clients for any language.
Generate type-safe API clients from the OpenAPI specification.
